subject: FT.DROPINDEX consistency check (#393)
reason: The change is real behaviour (FT.DROPINDEX in cluster mode now fans out a consistency check over the coordinator's gRPC channel, retrying until every node reports the index gone; gRPC NOT_FOUND is reclassified as INDEX_NAME_ERROR; FT.INFO CLUSTER retries on index-name errors), but every changed path is gated on IsCluster() && UsingCoordinator().
